group.title: Returning reusable shipping crates
group.titleZh: 可重複使用運輸箱回收通知
group.passage:
To: Regional store managers
Subject: Reusable crate collection

Beginning next Monday, our distribution center will collect reusable shipping crates during regular deliveries. The new arrangement is intended to reduce packaging waste without adding a separate collection trip. Please ask your receiving team to [131] ____ empty crates by size and place them near the loading entrance before the driver arrives.

Each crate carries a small identification label. Drivers will scan these labels and provide a digital receipt showing how many crates were collected. [132] ____ Please check it against your own records before the truck leaves. If a label is missing, set the crate aside and report the problem through the inventory portal.

Stores will not be charged for normal wear. However, crates damaged by improper storage may incur a replacement fee. To prevent such damage, keep all crates indoors, [133] ____ from heaters and direct sunlight. We will review the program after six weeks and make any [134] ____ adjustments based on your feedback.
group.passageZh:
收件者：各區門市經理
主旨：可重複使用運輸箱回收

下週一起，配送中心將在例行送貨時回收可重複使用的運輸箱。新安排旨在減少包材浪費，不必另行安排回收車次。請收貨團隊依尺寸 [131] ____ 空箱，並在司機抵達前放到裝卸入口附近。

每個箱子都有識別標籤。司機會掃描標籤，提供載明回收數量的電子收據。[132] ____ 請在貨車離開前，將這張收據與您自己的紀錄核對。如標籤遺失，請將箱子放一旁，透過庫存系統回報。

正常耗損不向門市收費；但因存放不當造成損壞，可能須支付更換費。為避免這類損壞，請將所有運輸箱放在室內，並 [133] ____ 暖氣設備與陽光直射處。我們會在六週後檢討計畫，根據各位回饋作出 [134] ____ 調整。
